records.source_title: Machines for processing wood, glass, stone, composites - Biesse (home page)
records.excerpt: Drawing on the expertise of our 4,400 employees, we fire the imagination of leading companies in their fields and in the world of design, enabling them to enhance the infinite potential inherent in materials.
records.population: Biesse group workforce and its customers
records.does_not_establish: The headcount is undated and says nothing about how many customers are small workshops or individuals.

records.source_title: About Us - Biesse
records.excerpt: We simplify the production processes of customers working in the furniture, construction, automotive and aerospace sectors, courtesy of the skill of the people who work in our production sites around the world.
records.population: Biesse customers by sector
records.does_not_establish: It names industrial sectors and a showroom network but gives no split of revenue by customer size.

records.source_title: Industrial woodworking machines for sale - Biesse
records.excerpt: We manufacture wood processing machines for the furniture, window and door and building component industries.
records.population: Buyers of Biesse wood-processing machines
records.does_not_establish: The absence of hobby or consumer buyers in this sentence does not prove Biesse never sells to them.

records.source_title: Press release: Annual Report as at 31 December 2025 approved (13 March 2026)
records.excerpt: FY 2025: equal to € 662.5 million (-12.2% compared to FY 2024)
records.population: Biesse group
records.does_not_establish: Group revenue does not show how much comes from entry-level machines or small buyers.

records.source_title: Press release: Consolidated Quarterly Financial Report as at 30 September 2026 approved
records.excerpt: As of September 30, 2026, the Biesse Group's order backlog amounted to €170.1 million, compared with €187.4 million at December 31, 2025 (-9.2%). The reduction mainly reflects softer order intake in the glass and stone businesses, while the wood segment proved more resilient in an environment that continues to be characterized by weak market demand.
records.population: Biesse group order book by business
records.does_not_establish: It does not say whether small-workshop demand within the wood segment is growing or shrinking.

records.source_title: Corriere della Sera: Interview with Roberto Selci - Biesse
records.excerpt: “China operates on a global scale with aggressive pricing strategies and growing production capacity. Today, it competes not only on volumes but also on technology, while maintaining a strong cost advantage. It is aggressively entering high-volume segments, while European players like us are increasingly challenged to defend margins that are under pressure.”
records.population: Biesse and its Chinese competitors
records.does_not_establish: The CEO's view of competition does not quantify Chinese share in small or entry-level machines.

records.source_title: Biesse Network - Biesse
records.excerpt: Over the years, Biesse has developed a widespread global presence through commercial locations, customer care and showrooms, ensuring direct contact with customers in every geographical area.
records.population: Biesse sales and service channels
records.does_not_establish: It does not say how many machines are sold through independent dealers rather than Biesse's own branches.

records.source_title: North America Finance Program - Biesse
records.excerpt: Because you can finance 100% of the transaction (unlike bank loans, which generally require a minimum 20% down payment), you retain more capital each month for growing your business.
records.population: Business buyers of Biesse equipment in North America
records.does_not_establish: It shows financing aimed at businesses, not whether individuals or hobbyists can or do use it.

records.source_title: Rover K Smart NC processing centre brochure (Biesse, 2019 edition, hosted by dealer Hoechsmann)
records.excerpt: Rover K Smart is a numerical control machining centre for artisan and small to medium sized businesses looking for simple solutions at affordable prices.
records.population: Artisans and small to medium-sized woodworking businesses
records.does_not_establish: The brochure gives no price and is a 2019 edition, so it does not show the current entry-level range or its cost.

records.source_title: Rover A: the craftsman’s choice - Biesse customer story
records.excerpt: With the CNC, dimensions are much more accurate and if you are working at the top end of the market, it’s a key consideration.
records.population: Small furniture workshop (Doig Furniture) that bought a Biesse Rover A
records.does_not_establish: One customer story chosen by Biesse does not show how many small workshops buy its machines.

records.source_title: Houtshop Van der Gucht - Biesse customer story
records.excerpt: “We serve different target groups: 35% of our customers belong to the B2B segment, while the remaining 65% belong to the B2C universe.”
records.population: A Biesse customer selling wood products to both businesses and consumers
records.does_not_establish: It shows Biesse reaching consumers only indirectly through a business customer, not selling to them itself.

records.source_title: Biesse offers compact entry-level CNC - Woodshop News
records.excerpt: “The Rover A Edge is an entry-level CNC machining center with a contouring edgebander unit on board. It has a smaller frame than the Rover C Edge, but we brought that same high-level of technology to this smaller machine so it could be affordable to a larger audience,” says Magnani.
records.population: Custom woodworking shops
records.does_not_establish: A 2012 product launch quote does not show the machine's price, current availability or sales to small shops.

records.source_title: Acimall reports a stable market in 2025 - Woodworking Network
records.excerpt: The Italian offer continues to be appreciated at home and abroad, remaining consistently in the high end of the market, focusing on top-notch technological solutions rather than price.
records.population: Italian woodworking machinery manufacturers
records.does_not_establish: It describes the Italian industry as a whole, not Biesse's own price position or any consumer segment.

records.source_title: Mobili made in Italy, innovazione, design e diversificazione per reagire alla guerra dei dazi - La Nazione
records.excerpt: La vocazione artigiana è elevata con 33.280 imprese artigiane, di cui 20.978 (71,0%) nel legno e 12.302 (37,0%) nei mobili.
records.population: Italian wood and furniture craft businesses
records.does_not_establish: A count of craft firms does not show how many would buy a CNC machine or at what price.

records.source_title: Wood craft ranked top U.S. hobby - Woodworking Network
records.excerpt: Woodworking hobbyists spend more on their craft - a total $3.32 billion - than other crafting enthusiasts. According to a new study by the Craft & Hobby Association, more than 16.8 million households do woodworking, earning the hobby the number four ranking, right after drawing (21 million households), scrapbooking (18.4 million) and crocheting (17.4 million).
records.population: US households doing woodworking as a hobby
records.does_not_establish: The 2010 survey covers all hobby woodworking spending, not spending on CNC machines, and is now old.

records.source_title: Join the desktop revolution - Woodshop News
records.excerpt: Today, the term has been adapted to include artists, engineers, hobbyists and a host of other creative people, including woodworkers. The core machine in many makerspaces is a versatile desktop CNC because it encourages people to conceive, design, and then actually build in three dimensions.
records.population: Small-shop woodworkers and makerspaces
records.does_not_establish: A columnist's description does not size the desktop CNC market or show who earns money in it.

records.source_title: Minimax - History - SCM Group
records.excerpt: The company currently produces over 10,000 machines annually at a 15,000 sq m plant located in Republic of San Marino. Minimax is a world leader in its sector. It offers an extremely wide range of products – more than 50 models – which provide advanced hobbyists, small carpentry and joinery shops with professional machines that can produce high-quality products in small batches.
records.population: Advanced hobbyists and small carpentry shops buying SCM's Minimax machines
records.does_not_establish: Minimax sells classical stand-alone machines, so its volumes do not show demand for small CNC machining centres.

records.source_title: Felder’s Hammer CNC Goes Industrial - Woodshop News
records.excerpt: "We wanted to offer a desktop CNC machine without compromising on our commitment to quality. Despite the possibility of creating a product that could be over-engineered for hobbyists, we took on the challenge,” Ruan du Toit, CEO of Felder Group USA, said in a statement.
records.population: Hobbyists and small shops buying Felder's Hammer brand
records.does_not_establish: A launch announcement does not show how many Hammer CNC machines sold or whether they are profitable.

records.source_title: After a Decade of Collaboration, Shaper Products Join the Festool Portfolio - Festool
records.excerpt: Since 2016, the TTS Group has watched with great interest as Shaper Tools introduced Origin, the world’s first and only handheld CNC router. Their commitment to digital precision and intuitive control immediately resonated with us, and the many thousands of craftspeople around the world, who quickly adopted Origin into their shops and workflows.
records.population: Craftspeople using the Shaper Origin handheld CNC router
records.does_not_establish: "Many thousands" of users is not an exact sales figure, and the release does not say how many are hobbyists.

records.source_title: Shapeoko CNC Routers - Carbide 3D
records.excerpt: Whether you’re working out of a garage or running a small production shop, you need a system that’s reliable, capable, and easy to grow with.
records.population: Garage and small-shop buyers of desktop CNC routers
records.does_not_establish: Marketing copy aimed at garages does not show these buyers would pay for a machine from an industrial maker like Biesse.

records.source_title: HSD Spindle Motors & Parts - CNC Parts Dept.
records.excerpt: HSD spindles are compatible with various CNC routers including: DMS, Freedom, Motionmaster, Biesse, Shopbot, Laguna Tools, Thermwood, Shop Sabre, Quintax, Techno CNC, AXYZ, Hendrick, Multicam, Multiax, Kimla, and Kuka robots.
records.population: Builders and users of third-party CNC routers fitted with HSD spindles
records.does_not_establish: Compatibility with brands like ShopBot does not show that HSD components are used in hobby-priced machines.

records.source_title: Regulation 2023/1230/EU - machinery - EU-OSHA
records.excerpt: When placing machinery or a related product on the market or putting it into service, manufacturers have to ensure that it has been designed and constructed in accordance with the essential health and safety requirements. They also have the responsibility to draw up the technical documentation and to carry out the relevant conformity assessment procedure.
records.population: Manufacturers placing machinery on the EU market
records.does_not_establish: It states general manufacturer duties and does not set specific rules for machines sold to non-professional users.
